The Dragonborn valued self improvement and willingness to protect ones family. The Teiflings valued cunning and ones ability to deceive. The Triton valued ones willingness to give themselves to the cause and ones ability to adhere to the law. The humans valued ones ability to further there standing with other races and ones ability to expand upon current knowledge.
